result.note: Tests the three requirements in the RBI's June 2026 draft rules on banks' use of AI; draft status noted in the stem.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, the Reserve Bank of India drafted rules on the use of artificial intelligence by banks. Consider the following statements about the draft rules:
items: They place banks' artificial intelligence under board-level control.
They require continuous assessment of model risk.
They require human oversight of automated decisions.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. The draft rules put banks' AI under board-level control, require continuous model-risk assessment and keep humans overseeing automated decisions. The RBI drafted these rules on 25 June 2026.
questions.source: The Reserve Bank of India drafted rules putting banks' artificial intelligence under board-level control, requiring continuous model-risk assessment and human oversight of automated decisions.
